title: Buttonhole Style Property (Ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective Use these options to edit buttonhole styles and materials. **** ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole **Viewport** Title Bar ▶ Right-click Dropdown menu ▶ Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole ### Operation Object Browser ▶ Select a buttonhole item in the Buttonhole Tab. → The properties are displayed in the Property Editor. Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Name | Enter a name of the Buttonhole. Shape | Select the type of the buttonhole from the drop down icon. Click the plus icon to[ register the Buttonhole as OBJ file](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358452715161). Width (mm) | Decide the width of the buttonhole by millimeters. Material Button / Thread | Type | Set the appropriate material for the Buttonhole. Base Color | Color | Select the color of the base color. Displacement Map | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder, generate with the generate icon. Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Opacity | Opacity | Adjust the opacity level from 0 to 100. Opacity Map | RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Reflection | Roughness | Dropdown menu | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness slider Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. or generate a custom map Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. The range of Roughness map intensity was enlarged in (ver. 2024.2) Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | The greater/lesser the Reflection Intensity value is, the more reflective/dull the material or fabric is. Metalness | Adjust metallic level. Higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic.
content_description: This web page provides users with the tools and options needed to customize buttonhole styles and materials for garment design.

title: Compatible File Format
content: ### File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, in addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar USD | *.usd | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. Serves as a universal interchange format for 3D content across various applications and platforms. For more information, please see the [USD file compatibility page.](USD%20file%20Compatibility) USDZ (ver. 2025.0) | *.usdz | X | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. It is a compressed package format that combines all 3D assets into a single file. Primarily used for AR/VR applications and interactive 3D content. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | *.sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive overview of supported file formats for importing and exporting 3D and 2D assets in Marvelous Designer, detailing their contents and compatibility.

title: Can I cancel my subscription?
content: #### _*** The annual license is only a one-time purchase license, and it won't be auto-renewed.**_ ## **[Personal Monthly License Holder]** Yes, if you're using a recurring subscription license, you can cancel your recurring subscription on [My account > License page. ](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license)(Click "Stop Subscription") ![mceclip0 \(2\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47448309723161) You can either choose**"Cancel Subscription"** or **"Pause Subscription"** of up to 6 months. _* Even if you cancel your subscription, you can continue using it for the remaining period until the license expires under the "**cancel scheduled** " status. Once the license expires, it will be completely canceled, and no additional charges will be incurred._ _* For annual license subscribers, the "Stop Subscription" button is not visible because the license does not renew automatically._ ## **[Personal Trial License Holder]** ![trial.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438478664473) You can cancel the trial by clicking the**Cancel Trial** button. No charges will be applied after the trial expires. _* Even if you cancel your Trial, you can continue using it for the remaining period until the trial expires under the "**cancel scheduled** " status. Once the license expires, it will be completely canceled, and no additional charges will be incurred._ #### **Personal License Status Details:** ✅ Active Your license is currently active, and payments are being processed as expected. You have full access to Marvelous Designer. ⏳ Pause Scheduled Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a pause has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled pause date. 🚫 Paused Your license remains active, but payments have been stopped, and Marvelous Designer is no longer accessible. 📅 Cancel Scheduled Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a cancellation has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled cancellation date. **Would you like to learn more about subscription pause?** 📖 View the manual: 🔗 [Can I pause my subscription?](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358159780505) * * * ## **[Enterprise Network Online Monthly License Holder]** Per cancellation to **Enterprise Network Online** Monthly plan, please follow the steps below. * [Log in ](https://marvelousdesigner.com/en/member/signin)with your **Company ID** on our website * Go to [License Account Admin page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/en/teamconsole) * Find the License ID that has the Network Online Monthly plan and click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438506845465) * Cancel the subscription at Active License list ![cancel_ent.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47448309727513) **Note** * You will be able to access your license until the current subscription date, and you can re-subscribe at any time after the license expiration. * Please note cancellation of subscription after the renewal is non-refundable.

title: AI Studio Plug-In Activation
content: ## Overview Marvelous Designer provides AI features as plug-in to support creators’ work. The default state is disabled, and the activation process may very depending on the license type. Follow the guide below to enable AI features and unlock new possibilities for creativity! ## License Type: Personal Individual users can control whether to enable or disable AI features in your account management page. 1. Log in to the [**Marvelous Designer Website**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/) with your account. 2. Go to **My Account → Account.** 3. Change the activation status of the **AI Studio Plug-In**. 4. The activation state will be applied after restarting the Marvelous Designer software. ## License: Enterprise For Enterprise License users, the availability of AI features for end users is managed by the account’s overall Administrator, in accordance with the company’s AI usage policy. Therefore, if you wish to activate AI features, please contact your company’s account administrator to request activation. Administrators can enable Marvelous Designer's AI features for their team according to their needs by following the guide below. 1. Log in to the [**Marvelous Designer Website**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/) with your Admin account. 2. Access the **License Account Admin > AI Studio Plug-In**. 3. Control **AI Feature Access** for each End-User with a License ID using the toggle. ## Available AI Feature #### AI Texture Generator (ver 2024.1) When you enter a keyword that symbolizes your envisioned design, the system will automatically generate a variety of fabric texture images related to that keyword. You can experiment with different ideas to produce multiple images, and then compare them to select the texture that best matches your desired style and mood. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358351055897--Beta-AI-Texture-Generator-Ver-2024-1) #### AI Graphic Generator (ver 2024.1) Simply type in a keyword, and a variety of graphic images related to that keyword will be automatically generated. You can then compare and select from the different versions to create a new graphic that matches your desired style and concept. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358161486361--Beta-AI-Graphic-Generator-Ver-2024-1) #### AI Pose Generator (ver 2025.1) You can easily create avatar poses using keywords or images. This feature allows you to intuitively bring your desired mood and movement to life without going through the complex process of 3D pose creation. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/48920289920537-AI-Pose-Generator-Beta) #### AI Pattern Drafter (ver 2025.1) Enter keywords or upload an image to automatically generate measurements and create a drafted pattern for you. This allows you to produce a basic garment pattern without requiring detailed pattern-making knowledge or experience, enabling you to quickly begin creating a wide range of creative designs. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/48920347302297-Pattern-Drafter-Beta) ## ##
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for enabling and utilizing AI features in Marvelous Designer, tailored for both personal and enterprise users, to enhance creativity and streamline design processes.

title: Keyframe Animation (ver. 2025.0)
content: YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-VbR6WqoAvc ### **Objective** By setting animation keys on an object’s properties, you can interpolate between keyframes to express animation over time. Edit the avatar’s joints to apply dynamic animations, or control the wind properties to create effects where the wind values change over time. Use these methods to create various animation effects. ### **Location** Main Menu ▶ Animation ▶ Animation Editor Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Animation Editor Bottom Window Center ▶![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438117745049) Open Animation Editor icon Side Panel Title Bar ▶ Right-click Dropdown menu ▶ Animation Editor ### ### **Add Keyframe** 1. Click Animation ▶ Animation Editor in the top menu. 2. Click the Add Animation button at the top left of the Animation Editor to view a list of objects that can have animations. 3. Select the target item to create an empty layer with no keyframes. 4. Expand the created layer, set the value of a property that can be keyed, and click the **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358157014681)**Insert Key button. _* This action works the same as clicking Insert Key in the Property Editor._ 5. Move the Current Frame, change the property value, and click Insert Key again to create another keyframe. 6. When you play the animation between the multiple keyframes, you can see the value change over time. ### ### **Animation Layer** 1. Right-clicking the created layer will display a context menu. 2. Layers have a hierarchical structure, and only the properties of an object that can be keyed are displayed as layers. 3. Layers can be deleted, and sub-property layers can be re-created using the Add Layer menu of the parent layer. An animation list item is structured as follows: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Active Button** | When the button is turned on, the keyframes in the layer become active and functional. Child layers are dependent on the active status of their parent layer. **Layer Name** | The top-level layer displays its name along with an icon. Property layers display only the name. The layer name is synchronized with the actual target’s name. **Parameter Value** | Shows the value of the corresponding property and allows you to edit it. This value is synchronized with the Property Editor and will update together. **Key Controller** | Enables the insertion of keyframes and provides navigation to the previous or next keyframe. **※Note** : Only recorded Cache Layer can be cut or merged. ### ### **Animation Track** **Object Layer** 1. The object layer displays the Start-End keyframe range as a bar. 2. Hover the mouse over the bar to display the handles and precisely adjust its length. 3. As the length of the bar changes, the keyframes in the child layers stretch or shrink while maintaining their relative spacing. **Property Layer** 1. Actual keyframes are set on property layers. 2. Property layers can also be grouped, and the parent key in the group represents the keys of its children. 3. When the parent key is selected, all child keys on the same frame are selected as well, and actions such as moving, copying, deleting, or changing interpolation type are applied collectively. ### ### **Set Keyframe** **Manual Keyframe Creation** 1. Change the property value of the target object in the Animation Layer or Property Editor, then click the Insert Keyframe button. 2. The current property value of the target object will be set as a key at the current frame. **Automatic Keyframe Creation** 1. Enable Auto Keying. 2. Manually set the first key using the manual creation method. 3. After the initial key is set, any changes to the same property will automatically create a key at the current frame. **※Note** : The first key must be manually set in order for subsequent keys to be created automatically on that property. **Create Keyframes or Layers in Batch** 1. When ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/52012119691801)**Add Keyframe for Selected Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , keyframes are created for all currently selected layers. 2. When ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/52012104000537)**Add Keyframe for All Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , keyframes are created for all layers. 3. When ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/52012119707673)**Create All Object Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , layers are created for all scene objects existing in the current world. **Copy and Paste Keyframes** 1. One or more keyframes can be copied and pasted relative to the current frame. 2. Meaningful paste results can only be achieved when pasting onto layers with the same data type. 3. When multiple keys are pasted, they retain the same spacing relative to the current frame. **Keyframe Interpolation Types** 1. To set the interpolation type, select keys and right-click to open the context menu. Choose the desired interpolation type from the menu. 2. Keyframe interpolation types can be set as follows: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Constant** | Maintains the current key's value until just before the next key. **Linear** | Creates a straight-line interpolation between keys, producing a constant rate of change. **Cubic** | Creates a curved interpolation between keys, resulting in smoother motion. This is visible when three or more keys are present. To apply the same interpolation type to all child keys, select the parent key of the property and change its interpolation type. All child keys will be updated accordingly. ### ### **Timeline Improvement** **Playback Range Context Menu** Use the following features to easily set the playback range. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Set Start Frame** | Sets the current frame as the start frame of the playback range. This menu is disabled if the current frame is larger than the end frame. **Set End Frame** | Sets the current frame as the end frame of the playback range. This menu is disabled if the current frame is less than the start frame. **Clamp Range to Active Frames** | Automatically adjusts the playback range to fit the span between the first and last keyframes across all layers. **※Note** : When **Clamp Range to Selected Layers** is executed from the track context menu of the selected animation layers, the playback range is adjusted to match the start and end keyframes of the selected layers. **S****lider Context Menu** Right-click the slider at the bottom of the Timeline and use the following options to control the Timeline view area. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Fit to Active Frames** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fit the Start Keyframe and End Keyframe. **Fit to Playback Range** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fit the Playback Range's Start Frame and End Frame. **Fit to Full Frames** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fir the defined Minimum Frame and Maximum Frame. **Supported Objects** Keyframe animation can be applied to the following objects: **Object** | **Description** ---|--- **Fabric** | The following properties can be controlled: * Front/Back/Side Material * Physical Property **※Note:** If **Use Same Material as Front** is enabled for the back/side material, it will not appear in the Layer. **Pattern** | The following properties can be controlled: * Fabric Index * Solidify (ver 2025.2) * Shrinkage Weft (%) (ver 2025.2) * Shrinkage Warp (%) (ver 2025.2) * Pressure (ver 2025.2) **※Note:** It is possible to transition between fabrics assigned to a pattern. When switching fabrics, the property values are interpolated. **Avatar** | The following properties can be controlled: * Joint **Pin** | The following properties can be controlled: * Activate **Tack** **(2025.2)** | The following properties can be controlled: * Tack: Activate * Tack: Thread Length (mm) * Line Tack: Activate * Line Tack: Thread Length (mm) **Wind Controller** | The following properties can be controlled: * Active * Unlimited Bound * Transform * Strength * Decay * Frequency * Turbulence **Simulation Property** | The following properties can be controlled: * Gravity * Air Damping **Cache** | Recorded Cache is classified into the following two types. **1\. Garment Cache** Caches recorded during simulation are keyed and categorized into **Pattern** and **Trim** Layers. **2\. Softbody Cache** Avatar motion recorded after enabling Softbody. **※Note:** Cache layers can be cut and merged individually by type.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to utilizing the Animation Editor in Marvelous Designer, detailing how to create dynamic animations using keyframes and various properties for objects like avatars and wind effects.

title: 3D Garment (*.zpac) Open/Add/Save

title: Can I Pause my Subscription?
content: ## **Q. Can I temporarily pause my subscription?** **A.** Yes, you can temporarily pause your subscription instead of canceling it. Your payment details will be saved, so you can easily resume your subscription without needing to repurchase it from scratch. _* Only personal monthly licenses can be paused. (Enterprise License, Student License, Trial License are not applicable)_ * * * ## ## **Subscription Pause** 1\. Log in to your account and go to the 'License' page. 2\. Click on **'Stop Subscription'**. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438238983705) 3\. Select **'Pause Subscription'** and choose a pause period of up to 6 months. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438283892633) 4\. Your subscription status will change to **'Pause Scheduled'** , meaning the pause will take effect once your current license expires. * * * ## ## **Additional Notes:** * While the status is **'Pause Scheduled'** , you can select **'Undo Pause'** to keep your subscription active. * During the pause period, you can **'Resume'** your subscription at any time before the pause ends. A new billing cycle will begin when you resume your subscription. * Any coupon discounts you have will still be valid after the pause period. * * * ## ## **Status Details:** #### ✅ **Active** Your license is currently active, and payments are being processed as expected. You have full access to Marvelous Designer. #### ⏳ **Pause Scheduled** Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a pause has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled pause date. #### 🚫 **Paused** Your license remains active, but payments have been stopped, and Marvelous Designer is no longer accessible. #### 📅 **Cancel Scheduled** Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a cancellation has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled cancellation date.
content_description: Discover how to easily pause your subscription for up to six months without losing your payment details, ensuring a seamless return to Marvelous Designer when you're ready.

title: Change Email from CLO-SET

Troubleshooting **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | VS | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438325824921) | ![emai switch.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438326034073) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO & Marvelous Designer license information if any. Please find instructions below on the **Change Email Guide**. * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO or Marvelous Designer license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please **[submit a ticket](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=44414746707993)**. #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on Marvelous Designer cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the **[troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129)** for further steps. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Visit 'my page' from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) , [**CLO**](https://clo3d.com/accounts), or [**Marvelous Designer**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account) to start the change email process ![mceclip0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438326290585) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO or Marvelous Designer service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438281413913) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![mceclip4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438281537689)![mceclip5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438326879129) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO or Marvelous Designer license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![mceclip12.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438327089433)![mceclip14.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438327433497) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the 'Email Switching' feature instead. 6\. Troubleshooting Should you experience an error while attempting to change the email address, please find the **[Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129)** for instructions. #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **License** Changing your email does not affect your license. You can change your email even if you have an active license, and you will be able to continue using your license with the new email. #### **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. title: System Requirements (July 2025)
content: # **Applicable for: All users of Marvelous Designer software** In this document, Marvelous Designer or Marvelous Designer software refers only to the Marvelous Designer software installed on the user's local computer, and does not refer to CLO-SET and various other CLO products. The hardware components presented in the documents and tables below have been tested directly by Marvelous Designer team or are listed based on feedback from Marvelous Designer users. Please note that Marvelous Designer team does not provide consulting services such as computer price quotes and hardware performance comparisons. So please carefully review the Marvelous Designer software installation and operating conditions described below. # **Windows** Category | **Minimum** | **Recommended** ---|---|--- OS | Windows 10 64-bit (1903 or later) | Windows 10 64-bit (22H2) 1) 2) 3) Windows 11 64-bit (24H2) Processor | AMD® Ryzen™ 5 1500X Intel® Core-i5 6400 | AMD® Ryzen™ 7/9 7000 series or higher Intel® Core-i7/i9 14th Gen or higher Memory | 8GB | 32GB or more 5 4) Graphics card | NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 960 orNVIDIA® Quadro P2200 | NVIDIA® GeForce RTX series or NVIDIA® Quadro RTX , RTX A, RTX Ada series 5) 6) 7) Storage | HDD 10GB or more | SSD 20GB or more Screen | 1920x1080(FHD) | 2560x1440(QHD), 3840x2160(UHD, 4K) Input device | 3-button mouse | 3-button mouse Network | Internet connection required | Internet connection required 1) Windows updates and patches are highly recommended. [Windows Update - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/install-windows-updates-3c5ae7fc-9fb6-9af1-1984-b5e0412c556a) 2) If dll-related errors occur while installing or running Marvelous Designer, install the latest Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable. X64 architecture is recommended. [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable latest supported downloads](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170) 3) Marvelous Designer software cannot run on Windows 10/11 N which media features removed. Download and install the Media Feature Pack from the Microsoft website. [Media Feature Pack for Windows 10/11 N (February 2023)](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/media-feature-pack-for-windows-10-11-n-february-2023-2aaf89b8-f9d3-4322-98d0-612c9bea9c01) 4) For smoother operation, 16GB or more of memory is recommended. 32GB or more of memory is recommended if you are using multiple software at the same time and/or dealing with huge and complex garments. 5) Marvelous Designer utilizes [Nvidia CUDA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CUDA) acceleration technology for Marvelous Designer GPU-Simulation and Rendering. So computers with only Intel Graphics or AMD graphics card do not benefit from GPU acceleration that speeds up Marvelous Designer simulation. If you want faster GPU-simulation in Marvelous Designer software, look for a computer with a recent Nvidia graphics card. 6) For graphics card related issues, please see the following guide. In particular, please update your graphics card driver to the latest. [Graphics Card Problems and Troubleshooting](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358166752793) 7) A GPU that supports OpenGL Compatibility Profile 1.3 or higher is required to run Marvelous Designer software. Some mobile GPU processors from AMD and Intel may not fully support [OpenGL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenGL), which is essential for running Marvelous Designer software, and may not run Marvelous Designer software. If you are using a laptop or graphics card with a built-in CPU, check with the hardware manufacturer for the GPU model and whether it supports OpenGL. * * * # # **Mac** Category | **Minimum** | **Recommended** ---|---|--- Mac models | All Macs released after 2016 1) 2) | Apple Silicon Macs: M1, M2, M3, M4 macOS | Monterey 12 *For macOS dependencies, check out the notes below 3) | Ventura 13, Sonoma 14, Sequoia 15 Processor | Intel® Core-i5 4cores | Apple Silicon 4) 5) Memory | 8GB | 24GB or more Storage | HDD 10GB or more | SSD 20GB or more Screen | 1280x800 | Retina 4K, Retina 5K supported Input devices | 3-button mouse | 3-button mouse Network | Internet connection required | Internet connection required 1) Starting with Marvelous Designer 2024, the minimum macOS has been changed to Monterey 12. See which macs are compatible with macOS Monterey 12 here. [macOS Monterey is compatible with these computers.](https://support.apple.com/en-us/103260) 2) Intel chip macs do not have Nvidia graphics cards, so mac users cannot make use of GPU acceleration, but simulation and rendering are supported normally. 3) macOS dependencies * Sierra 10.12: users can install and run up to Marvelous Designer 9. * High Sierra 10.13: users can install and run up to Marvelous Designer 10. * Mojave 10.14: users can install and run up to Marvelous Designer 10. * Catalina 10.15: users can install and run up to Marvelous Designer 12. * Please note that Marvelous Designer 11 and future versions will not run on macOS Mojave or earlier. 4) As of Marvelous Designer 11, provides as a compatible build for both Apple Silicon macs and Intel chip macs. If you want to use version 10 or lower on Apple Silicon Mac, you need to install Apple Rosetta. Visit here for more info. [If you need to install Rosetta on your Mac: Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/102527) * * * ## # **See also** * Marvelous Designer software does not support garment pattern digitizers. * Marvelous Designer software have tested and supports Wacom® tablet products, and compatibility issues may occur with third-party tablets. * Marvelous Designer software does not support BootCamp in macOS, also does not support similar desktop virtualization apps. * Marvelous Designer software does not support 32-bit OS (e.g. Windows 7 32-bit), Apple iOS, iPad OS, tvOS, Android OS, ChromeOS, Windows Mobile and Linux. * Marvelous Designer software can be downloaded as .exe or .dmg file format via [Marvelous Designer official website](https://marvelousdesigner.com/product/download). It is not distributed in .msi or .pkg file format. * Marvelous Designer software can be installed and run in virtual server environments such as Virtual Machine and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure and in cloud services. However, in this case, Marvelous Designer team does not provide technical support.

title: Simulation Properties
content: ### Objective Configure the simulation properties for advanced scene settings. ### Location Object Browser ▶ ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358131961369) Scene ▶ Environment ▶ Simulation Properties Right-Click 3D background ▶ 3D Background Options ▶ Simulation Properties ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → The simulation properties appear in the Property Editor. 2. Refer to the below table and edit the simulation properties as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- Use the Folder Icon to open the File Explorer to import a custom setting. Use the Save icon to save custom settings. Preset | Instead of selecting the [simulation mode](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358232630937) from the 3D toolbar, you can choose predefined presets below are primarily used. * Normal (Default) * Animation (Stable) * Fitting (accurate Fabric) Time Step | This determines the time values calculated within the simulation engine. The smaller you set it, the more sophisticated it will be, but it will also require more calculations and will, resultingly, be slower. The default values are recommended. Simulations Per Frame (Simulation Quality) | When calculating cloth simulation for a given time step, this denotes how many substeps one simulation calculation is divided into. For example, if you are calculating a time step of 0.03 and number of simulation is 10, the actual time step will be 0.003. Simulating multiple times with these smaller time intervals ensures both more numerically accurate results and stable collision handling, but takes much longer. CG Finish Condition | Clothing simulation is the process of solving a large linear system. Large linear systems can be solved using a numerical analysis method called conjugate gradient method (CG). CG improves the accuracy of the answer through iterative calculations. The condition for CG ending can be set by the number of iterations or when the error (=residual) falls below a certain value. CG Iteration Count | Iteration: Because it repeats only a certain number of times and ends unconditionally, it is faster but may be less accurate. CG Residual | Residual: It is slower but can be more accurate because it stops when the error falls below a certain value. Self Collision Iteration Count | Defines the number of collision calculations for the clothing. More collision calculations produce more precise results, but they are also slower. Please use the default value. Air Damping | The resistance that the garment receives from the air. Gravity | Defines the most important gravity values in your simulation. If this value is adjusted, simulation results will become unrealistic. Please use the default value, unless you want to, for example, create a weightless simulation. Default is -9800 (0 results in no gravity and positive values can achieve other interesting results) Number of CPU in Use | This determines the number of physical cores within the CPU that will be used for the simulation. Marvelous Designer can technically use up to 12 cores, which are automatically defined based on your computer. Even if it is a high-end CPU with 16 cores, up to 12 can be used. This may vary depending on the CPU manufacturer and actual CPU products. This value is best also left at default. Nonlinear Simulation | Linear or non-linear is an important factor in all fields of computer graphics, simulation, rendering and engineering. By analogy, the real world is non-linear, but computer implementations are linear. Nonlinearity is a technique that makes things look very real, and simulating them this way is sophisticated, but slow. If Fitting simulation is run, this option is selected. t's slower because it's more complicated and requires a lot of calculations. **Collision Simulation Options** Ground | All of these are intended to simulate collisions and friction between the clothing and the avatar. Because Marvelous Designer calculates numerous contacts and collisions between the fabric and the body, the simulation looks natural and realistic. It is recommended that these values are also left at their default. ---|--- Avatar-Cloth Collision Detection | Toggle On/ Off * Triangle-vertex * Edge-Edge Self-Collision Detection | Toggle On/ Off * Triangle-vertex * Edge-Edge Avoidance Stiffness (adjustable property, default is [0.001000] ) Proximity Detection | Toggle On/ Off * Triangle-vertex * Edge-Edge **Collision Resolution Options** Intersection Resolution | Toggle on / off Allow Normal / Flipped Normal values to set direction and resolve intersecting mesh issues. ---|--- Layer Based Collision Detection | Toggle on / off Allow layers & Sublayers to set Collision values. (example: layer 1 will be on top of layers 0 and below) ※ Note: Use the Open &Save buttons on the top of the Property Editor to save, open, and reuse the settings.

title: Create Line (Avatar) / 3D Pen (Avatar)
content: ### Objective Draw lines on an Avatar and extract Patterns. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ Line (Avatar) / 3D Pen (Avatar) (ver. 2025.0) 3D Toolbar ▶ Line (Avatar) / 3D Pen (Avatar) (ver. 2025.0) ### Operation 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location section. → If there is a Garment on the Avatar, the Garment appears translucent. 2. Hover the mouse over the Avatar. → A black dot follows the mouse. 3. Click on the desired position on the Avatar to create lines or shapes. → The lines or shapes appear on the Avatar in black. 4. Click on the start point to complete drawing the line. → The lines or shapes are created on the Avatar. **Updated 2025.1** Press **P** to switch between creating point within the 3D space or on the avatar. ※ Note: * To create a curve point while drawing lines on the Avatar, hold down the Ctrl key on the keyboard and click on the Avatar. * Hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the latest action or hit the Esc key or Ctrl+Z to cancel all actions. * All lines and shapes drawn on the Avatar are saved when you save the file in Project, Garment, or Avatar file format.
content_description: This web page provides instructions for drawing lines and shapes on a 3D avatar to extract patterns for garment design.

title: Edit Line (Avatar) / Edit 3D Pen (Avatar)
content: ### Objective Edit lines created on an Avatar. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ Edit Line (Avatar) / Edit 3D Pen (Avatar) (ver. 2025.0) 3D Toolbar ▶ Edit Line (Avatar) / Edit 3D Pen (Avatar) (ver. 2025.0) ### Operation #### Select/Move 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location section. → If a Garment is on the Avatar, the Garment appears translucent. 2. Click on the line or the shape to be selected. → The line or the shape is selected and highlighted in yellow. 3. While the line of the shape is selected, click and drag to move the selected item to the desired position. #### Delete 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location section. → If a Garment is on the Avatar, the Garment appears translucent. 2. Select the line or the shape to be deleted. 3. Right click on the selected item and select Delete or hit the Delete key on the keyboard. → The selected line or shape is deleted. ※ Note: * To select multiple lines or shapes, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard, then click on additional lines or shapes. * To select all lines and shapes on the Avatar, hit the Ctrl+A on the keyboard. * After the lines and shapes are drawn on the Avatar, if you delete the Avatar, all previously created lines, and shapes are also deleted.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on how to edit, move, and delete lines and shapes created on an Avatar within the 3D Garment editing tool.

title: Avatar IK Joint Mapping (2025.0)
content: YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrfygGSENOY ### Objective Streamline IK joint mapping for various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars. The avatar must have properly defined joint points. Rigging must include key joints such as shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, knees, and ankles. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ IK Joint tab ### IK Joint Mapping ※ Note: The FBX file must not contain joints with duplicate names, and IK mapping may not apply correctly for creatures or quadruped avatars with non-human structures. Joints are categorized into required and optional, and you must map all required joints to ensure proper IK setup. ![IK.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438084949529) For optional joints, we recommend mapping those indicated in the image if they are present in the avatar to achieve more accurate results. ## ![IK_Optional.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438039415193) **1\. Auto Mapping** If the avatar meets the following conditions, click the Auto Mapping at the top right to apply automatic mapping. • If each joint name of the avatar matches that of the Marvelous Designer avatar. • If the avatar is from one of the following platforms: Daz 3D, Adobe Mixamo, Reallusion Character Creator, or Unreal Engine MetaHuman. **2\. Manual Mapping** 1\. Click the desired item from the image or list in the IK Mapping tab, then click the joint to be mapped on the avatar in the 3D Window. * Alternatively, you can first click the joint on the avatar and then click an item from the tab. 2\. When Symmetry Mapping option at the top right is turned on, the corresponding joint on the opposite side is automatically mapped. Note that both sides must be named as follows: Left_/Right_, L_ / R_,Left / Right,_L / _R,_Left / _Right. 3\. Once all mapping is set up, adjust IK Pose. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438053745049) ### Set Pose Set the avatar in a T-pose to ensure proper compatibility with Marvelous Designer avatar pose and motion files apply correctly. 1\. Adjust the avatar’s joints directly to a T-pose using the gizmo in the 3D window. * If the avatar is already in a T-pose, this step can be skipped. 2\. Click the Set T-Pose at the top right. **※ Note:** • If set correctly, the Reset Pose activates, allowing you to check the set T-pose when clicked. • After adjusting the pose during IK mapping, click the Reset Pose button to revert the avatar to the set T-pose. **Open/Save** You can manage the IK data mapped to the avatar as a file. * Click Open/Save at the top right to open or save IK data as a .iks file. * IK files are only compatible between avatars that have been mapped.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for streamlining IK joint mapping across various avatars to enable natural movement and ensure compatibility for motions and poses in Marvelous Designer.

title: 3D File (FBX) Import/Export
content: ### Objective Import a file's Geometry, Material, Joint, and Camera Animation information in the FBX file format (ver2.2.0). ### Location #### Import FBX Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ FBX #### Export FBX Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ FBX ### Operation #### Import FBX 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ FBX → The Open File window appears. 2. Select the desired file and click OK. → The Import FBX window appears. 3. Select the settings and click OK. → The FBX file is imported based on the setting. Load Type | Open | All existing objects will be removed, leaving the imported FBX file only. ---|---|--- Add | Add a FBX file, keeping the existing objects. Auto Create Fitting Suit | For humanoid avatars only, a Fitting Suit is automatically created in the import process. Object Type | Avatar | Import a FBX file as an Avatar type. \- Objects imported as an Avatar type can be muti-selected. Trim | Import a FBX file as a Trim type. \- The object will pass through the clothing while Simulation is on, as the Trim type cannot collide with clothing. \- Set the collide option for a Trim type on the Property Editor by toggling on the Collision check-box. \- Select an trim object and toggle on the Glue icon on the gizmo to attach the object to clothing. \- Toggle on the Scale icon on the gizmo to scale the size of an object. Scene & Props | Import FBX file in Scene & Props format. \- You can use the Collision menu in the property window. Object | Camera | Toggles whether the Camera data or Camera Animation data is imported Joint Animation | Toggles whether the Joint Animation date is imported. Cache Animation (mc) | Toggles whether the Cache Animation data is imported. Automatically Add Arrangement Points | For humanoid avatars only, arrangement points are automatically generated in the import process. Scale | Input the Specific Value or Choose Measure. Axis Conversion | Modifying Object's Axis direction.(ver. 12.2) Translation | Align Bottom to Ground | When an object is placed below the ground, toggle on Align Bottom to Ground check-box to place the object imported above ground. Option | Move Garment to Start Position | Move the garment to the starting frame of the imported motion. #### Export FBX 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ FBX → The Save File window appears. 2. Designate the file saving path and file name, and then click OK. → The Export OBJ window appears. 3. Select the settings as needed and click OK. → The file is exported as a FBX file based on the setting. Object | Select an Avatar (ver 6.1) Select the avatar to be exported. ※ Note: The selected avatar is saved with its rigging data. You can exclude it as desired. Select All Avatars (ver. 12.2) \- All existing avatars will be exported. ---|--- Single Object Exports the selected object as a single object. | Multiple Objects Exports the selected object as multiple objects. Un-Weld Exports the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into multiple objects. ※ Thickness exports for quad meshes available beginning version 2.3.0 (ver2.3.0). | Weld Combines the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into one point. Weld Selected Pattern: Weld based on the sewing line that connects the selected patterns (ver2.3.0). Thin Ensures that the thickness will not be exported even if the rendering thickness value is increased beforehand. ※ Note: * When an object is exported as a single object, its texture is exported as a whole even when its sides (front, back, and side) have different textures (ver5.0.0.) | Thick Exports a pattern with its rendering thickness values in its increased state. ※ Note: * The thickness can be exported when Pattern Mesh is Quadrangular (ver2.3.0.) * Each side's texture is exported individually when an object's front, back, side have different textures (ver5.0.0.) Combined UV Coordinates: Exports all Garment Pattern texture data fit to UV Coordinates ranging from 0 to 1. ※Note: Unified Texture (ver3.1.0). Export multiple layers of texture information as a single UV texture information. | Image File | Designate file saving path and file name. Add numbers behind the file name as below: ‘File Name_0’, ‘File Name_1’. ---|--- Texture Size | Width and Height will be saved in a fixed ratio. Allowance: 512 ~ 8192 Pixel Fill Texture Seams | Expands the scope of the texture having its boundary line as the standard. Allowance: 0 ~ 15 mm When you type in values, preview will show in the 2D Window. Animation | Joint Animation: Saves the animation data that was originally imported with the FBX file. Cache Animation (MC): Saves the cache data along with the recorded Garment Animation. Scale | Adjusts the scale of the file being exported when a value is entered or the desired unit from “Unit in file to import” is selected. Axis Conversion | Changes the directions of each axis of the object. Animation | Entire Area (saves all of the recorded garment animation.) | Play Area Only (saves only the play area garment animation.) File | File Type: Select between Binary or Ascii file type. * Binary: The file is saved in binary and cannot be opened by users. * Ascii: The file is saved as text and can be opened by users. Relative Texture Image File Path: Saves the texture image name without a texture image file path. Texture images are saved in the same folder as the FBX file, for automatic import. Absolute Texture Image File Path: Saves the file path that contained the texture images as the texture file path. If the texture image file path is changed, texture images cannot be imported. Save With Texture Files (.zip): Exports the .obj file, .mtl file, and texture images used in the garment as one compressed file when exporting animation. ※ Note: 1. FBX SDK 2020 version is available. (ver 10) * Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. 2. Import/Export FBX with multiple avatars (ver 12.2) * Multiple avatars can be imported or exported simultaneously using the FBX file format. 3. Export FBX with Material Names (Ver 2025.0) * Material Names are now synchronized exported with the FBX.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for importing and exporting FBX files, detailing the necessary steps and customizable settings for geometry, materials, joint animations, and camera data.

title: Adjust Avatar Pose
content: ### Objective Adjust poses of avatar with joint information. From ver2.3.0 onwards, it displays sub-groups of avatar joints which enables to see direct groups of joint to be edited. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Avatar ▶ Show X-ray Joints (Shift + X) / Show Avatar Joints (ver 12) ▶ 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move 3D Window ▶ Avatar Display (Mouse-over) ▶ Show X-ray Joints (Shift + X) / Show Avatar Joints (ver 12) ▶ 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ### Operation #### FK (Forward Kinematics) 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location section. 2. Click on avatar's joint and use Gizmo to relocate and to edit rotation value. Click the 'Symmetric' icon at the top right of the gizmo to apply the rotation value of the joint point in a metric fashion. (ver. 5.1.431) #### IK (Inverse Kinematics) (ver. 2025.0) 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location section. 2. Set Option as needed: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- Edit Full Body | When a single joint is modified, it affects all other joints which are organically linked to the single joint. Edit Body Part | When a single joint is modified, only directly connected joints are modified. Constrain Joint Rotation | Activate the option to prevent unwanted movement of the selected joint caused by other rotating joints. However, for natural modification of the Avatar, the constrained joint may rotate slightly. Constrain Joint Translation | Activate the option to prevent unwanted movement of the selected joint caused by other moving joints. However, for natural modification of the Avatar, the constrained joint may move slightly. 3. Adjust the position and rotation by clicking on the joints in the Gizmo. Joints marked with green dots can be adjusted. Click the symmetry icon on the top right of gizmo to enable symmetric editing.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for adjusting avatar poses using joint information, featuring enhanced editing capabilities for both Forward and Inverse Kinematics.
